# netbox_notification_group (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/features/notifications/):

> A notification group is a set of users and groups that receive the same notifications.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_notification_group" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the notification group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the notification group.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the group associated with the notification group.
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the user associated with the notification group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_notification_group.example 1
```
